description: This is a course providing students fundamental mathematical knowledge that is useful in a wide range of scientific disciplines. The scope of this course covers the basic mathematical concepts and techniques in linear algebra, calculus, and probability. Major topics include: matrices and vectors, solving linear systems, diagonalisation of matrices, differentiation and integration, random variables and probability density functions, law of large numbers, and central limit theorem.
